Here are all the available API endpoints for the ApartmentCorp Management KPI Tracker:

**Authentication**
| Endpoint | Method | Description |
|----------|--------|-------------|
| `/api/trpc/auth.me` | GET | Get current authenticated user info |
| `/api/trpc/auth.logout` | POST | Log out and clear session cookie |

**Managers**
| Endpoint | Method | Description |
|----------|--------|-------------|
| `/api/trpc/managers.list` | GET | List all managers with their buildings, metrics, and scores |
| `/api/trpc/managers.getById` | GET | Get a single manager's full details by ID |
| `/api/trpc/managers.getBySlug` | GET | Get a single manager by URL slug |
| `/api/trpc/managers.update` | POST | Update a manager's info (name, email, phone, region, role, training status) |

**Buildings**
| Endpoint | Method | Description |
|----------|--------|-------------|
| `/api/trpc/buildings.list` | GET | List all buildings with vacancy data |
| `/api/trpc/buildings.getByManager` | GET | Get all buildings for a specific manager |
| `/api/trpc/buildings.update` | POST | Update building info (units, vacancy, address) |

**Metrics**
| Endpoint | Method | Description |
|----------|--------|-------------|
| `/api/trpc/metrics.getLatest` | GET | Get the latest metrics snapshot for a building |
| `/api/trpc/metrics.getHistory` | GET | Get historical metrics snapshots for a building |
| `/api/trpc/metrics.create` | POST | Create a new metrics snapshot for a building |

**Vacancy Changes**
| Endpoint | Method | Description |
|----------|--------|-------------|
| `/api/trpc/vacancyChanges.list` | GET | List all recent vacancy changes across all buildings |
| `/api/trpc/vacancyChanges.create` | POST | Record a new vacancy change event |

**Dashboard**
| Endpoint | Method | Description |
|----------|--------|-------------|
| `/api/trpc/dashboard.overview` | GET | Get the full dashboard overview (total managers, buildings, units, vacant, avg score, alerts) |

**System**
| Endpoint | Method | Description |
|----------|--------|-------------|
| `/api/trpc/system.notifyOwner` | POST | Send a notification to the project owner |

All endpoints are accessible at `https://kpitracker-pncgyhgj.manus.space/api/trpc/[endpoint]` and use tRPC protocol with SuperJSON serialization. Protected endpoints require authentication via session cookie.
